sections.html:
Small-batch print, big-day detail

Custom invitations and weekend print workshops from a working letterpress studio.

We pair hand-mixed inks, cotton papers, and antique presses to make tactile wedding suites, launch cards, and private workshop days in our bright canal-side shop.

Start a commission View workshops

What we make

Designed slowly, printed with pressure.

01

Wedding suites

Save-the-dates, invitations, envelopes, menus, and place cards with one consistent print system.

02

Brand paper goods

Launch notes, thank-you cards, certificates, and packaging inserts for small brands.

03

Studio workshops

Four-hour Saturday sessions for beginners, teams, and design students.

Invitation families

Three print moods, each built for customization.

Every family starts with a consultation, paper pull, ink drawdown, and a physical proof before the final press run.

01 / Garden formal

Olive ink, soft deckle, blind pressed border.

02 / City evening

Graphite type, foil flash, architectural spacing.

03 / Orchard lunch

Persimmon accents, warm cotton stock, playful map insert.

Next sessions

Weekend workshops for people who want ink under their fingernails.

July 11

Intro to platen press

Set type, lock a chase, print a two-color postcard, and take home fifty copies.

July 25

Wedding proof day

Bring your suite draft and leave with paper, ink, and finishing decisions resolved.

Process

A tactile production path with no mystery middle.

  1. BriefWe define mood, quantities, wording, and practical deadlines.
  2. Material pullWe compare cotton papers, envelope colors, inks, and finishes.
  3. Physical proofYou approve a real printed sample before the full edition starts.
  4. Press runWe print, trim, assemble, and pack the finished suite.

Press consult

Tell us what needs to feel unforgettable on paper.

Share a date, quantity, and the kind of printed object you are imagining. We reply within two studio days.
